protected_invariants.heading: Purpose
protected_invariants.text: Use this before you create a commit, before you push a branch, before an MR/PR is merged, or after a fix commit has been prepared. Do not use this capability to modify files or apply reviewer feedback; use `engos-delivery-address-code-review` when the user wants selected PR/MR review comments implemented.

protected_invariants.heading: Choose the Right Review Capability
protected_invariants.text: Default to `engos-quality-code-review` for pre-commit or pre-push checks. Switch to `engos-delivery-address-code-review` only when the user explicitly wants to inspect and implement existing PR/MR review comments.
